help.enable:
usage: ophiolite procedures enable [-h] [--json] --version VERSION [--configuration CONFIGURATION]
                                   [--credentials CREDENTIALS]
                                   name

positional arguments:
  name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                Print the documented JSON result (errors as {"error": {...}})
  --version VERSION
  --configuration CONFIGURATION
  --credentials CREDENTIALS

help.run:
usage: ophiolite procedures run [-h] [--json] [--from-project NAME] [--version VERSION] [--yes]
                                --output OUTPUT [--input INPUT] [--kind KIND]
                                [--declared DECLARED] [--system SYSTEM] [--setting SETTING]
                                [--configuration CONFIGURATION] [--credentials CREDENTIALS]
                                [folder]

positional arguments:
  folder                The procedure folder (or --from-project NAME)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                Print the documented JSON result (errors as {"error": {...}})
  --from-project NAME   Run a version from the project's catalogue instead of a folder (E105b):
                        the highest enabled one, or --version
  --version VERSION     With --from-project: this version number (your own private ones included)
  --yes                 With --from-project: trust the version without asking (recorded as your
                        trust)
  --output OUTPUT       A new folder for the outputs
  --input INPUT         SLOT=PATH; repeat for each file
  --kind KIND           SLOT=KIND: the type of data of a file that is not an earlier run's output
  --declared DECLARED   SLOT=PATH: a JSON file of that data's declarations
  --system SYSTEM       SLOT=PATH: a local JSON file with a source's connection settings (never
                        recorded)
  --setting SETTING     NAME=VALUE; once per setting
  --configuration CONFIGURATION
  --credentials CREDENTIALS
